sync.options.masksHint: Masks like *.pdf *.docx. Masks after | are left out. A trailing / means a folder.
sync.options.excludesHint: Names never compared, separated by ;. A trailing / means a folder.

sync.error.noSuchItem: That row isn’t in the list anymore. Compare again.

sync.error.nestedRight: The left folder is inside the right one. Open two folders apart from each other.
sync.error.maskEmpty: One of the masks is empty. Check for a | or a ; with nothing after it.
sync.error.maskQuote: A quote in the masks never closes.
sync.error.maskSecondBar: The masks have more than one |. Put every mask to leave out after one |.
sync.error.badSettings: A Synchronize folders setting is out of range. Check it in Settings.

sync.error.sideReadOnlyLeft: The left side takes no changes, and this mode would write there.
sync.error.sideReadOnlyRight: The right side takes no changes, and this mode would write there.

sync.error.staleSelectionRight: The selection in the right pane changed. Turn off Only selected, or close and open Synchronize folders again.
sync.error.compareRunning: A compare is still running. Wait for it, or stop it.
sync.error.runInProgress: A synchronization is running for these folders. Wait for it to finish.
sync.error.planChanged: The list changed since you reviewed it. Review it again.
sync.error.staleCompare: A synchronization changed these folders. Compare again.

sync.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, send an error report from the Help menu.
